_help: Which airlines use each concourse, kept by hand. slug is the airline's page address (data/airlines.json). checked is true once confirmed against FlyPDX or the Port of Portland; unchecked ones show as unconfirmed on the Inside PDX page. note is optional, shown after the airline's name. no_aircraft lists gates where the model should not draw a parked plane, for spots where one could not really park.
